notes.title: 🦜DevLog #10 - Demo Update!
notes.notes:
[p]A new demo update is here, introducing new species, visual enhancements, and a range of quality-of-life improvements, bug fixes, and optimizations to make your pet shop even smoother to manage. [/p][p]  [/p][hr][/hr][h3]
Changelog[/h3][p][b]Added:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]3 Piranhas[/b] [i]Fierce and fast. A dangerous but fascinating addition to any aquarium section.

[/i][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869038/5a895c0365dbb3fc02e2bd58529053f011c8a714.png"][/img] [/p][/*][*][p][b]4 Goldfish:[/b] [i]A colorful and relaxing classic. These peaceful fish are perfect for beginner pet shop owners.

[/i][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869038/650f98b659bdfeacab76c9520597bcc4745d6e73.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]1 Hyacinth Macaw[/b] [i]Bright blue and highly intelligent - this large parrot brings energy and personality to your bird enclosures.[/i]   [/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The [b]animal type is now displayed[/b] on the screen when using animal transport bags[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lamp lighting visuals[/b] have been improved - illuminated areas are now more clearly visible[/p][/*][*][p][b]NPC positions[/b] near habitats and shelves have been rebalanced for better spacing and realism[/p][/*][*][p][b]Aquarium fish capacity doubled[/b] – you can now house more fish in each tank[/p][/*][*][p]Terrarium stands now show the [b]maximum number of animals[/b] instead of the minimum (note: large species will still limit how many can be added)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Character limit applied[/b] to the names of adopted animals[/p][/*][*][p][b]Windows and doors are now included[/b] in quick wall painting when using the Shift key[/p][/*][*][p][b]Product stands optimized[/b] for better performance and stability   
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]delivery area could be positioned outside the map[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where a worker would [b]still start mop-cleaning animations after the player finished the task[/b] [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Other:[/b][/p][list][*][p] The character's [b]jumping feature has been removed[/b] for improved gameplay consistency[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869038/b50de4bd30d07d80f3090f5a7e70d0beb57e281e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869038/abe3d8600239b08e16d07dabe5fc03f3eb2b2c62.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Thanks for playing! [/b][/p][p]More species, systems, and updates are in development - stay tuned. [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2824380/Exotica_Pet_Shop_Simulator_2"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update | 27-06-2025
notes.notes: [h3]Roof Placement is now easier![/h3][p]The roof installation system has been changed to an easier system! It’s now much more intuitive - no more needing to paint the roof walls manually. You can see the difference in the below before-and-after comparison. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="MeUQ3x73agY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]Changelog[/h3][p] [b]Added/New[/b][/p][list][*][p]A new shortcut has been added to the Tools Menu for easier access to "Q" feed slots. Swapping between feeds is now much smoother.[/p][/*][*][p]A character limit has been added to signs. (Max: 10 letters)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Roof placement method updated[/b] - It's now easier and doesn't require painting the roof walls.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Working agency renewal shortened[/b] - Now set to 7 days instead of 15.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Animal placement animation removed[/b] -Dropping animals into their habitats is now instant.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bed and bowl split[/b] - Beds and food bowls for adopted animals are now separate objects, both found in construction mode.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Feed/accessory placement reworked[/b] - You no longer get locked in place while placing multiple items. Just hold LMB to place, or use "C" to collect back into the box fluidly.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved: Storekeeper behavior has been optimized.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted: Store leveling now requires less EXP - level up faster![/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed: Workers no longer leave items floating mid-air when dismissed mid-task.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed: You can’t place the computer desk outside anymore.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed: Signs now correctly attach to the edges of new roofs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed: Construction mode now remembers the last object’s placement direction properly. [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Update | 13-06-2025
notes.notes: [p]Hello,[/p][p]We released a small update with some QoL improvements and fixes. Thank you very much for the feedback![/p][p][/p][h2]Changelog[/h2][p][b]ADDITIONS[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added ability to open/close shop and send customers out of the store.[/p][/*][*][p]Added previously missing WASD and zoom key indicators in Build Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a video tutorial to the tutorial screen displayed at game start. (Videos can be accessed later from the computer.)[/p][/*][*][p]Added functionality to move icons within the computer interface by holding and dragging, with support for single-key opening.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]FIXES[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue preventing doors from being placed on the map border.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed roofs were incorrectly placed over the Delivery Area.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where bank loans were incorrectly processed without requiring players to have twice the loan amount available. Now, players must have twice the loan amount in their account to take out a loan, and a warning message has been added to inform players of this requirement.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed object selection not exiting properly when clicking on another object in Build Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where players could select equipment from the tools menu and use it simultaneously while placing furniture, animals, food, or accessories.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed feeding animals across multiple living areas simultaneously.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed furniture placement issue where players could throw furniture boxes upon opening, leaving them open and preventing proper placement or exit from placement mode.[/p][/*][/list]
